newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK thieves ring in New Year by stealing phones.
newsitem.headline: HK thieves ring in New Year by stealing phones.

text.p: Thieves in Hong Kong rang in the New Year on Tuesday by making off with 40 cartons of mobile phones worth HK$9.8 million (US$1.27 million), police said.
Three culprits tied up four staff at a trading company in the Sha Tin area with plastic handcuffs and tape before ransacking the offices and carting off the boxes, police said.
No arrests have been made, they said.
But police may have trouble tracking down the stolen goods in a territory where about one in every six people has a mobile phone.
